CommunityApplications.Profile:
**PaperRust** is a fast, lean document archive that works with your paperless-ngx data: a re-implementation of paperless-ngx 3.4.2 in Rust with the same database, files and REST API, running as one container next to PostgreSQL (no Redis, Celery, Tika or Gotenberg).
This repository holds the official Unraid templates maintained by the PaperRust project:
- **paperrust** – the PaperRust server (web UI, worker, scheduler and consumption folder in one process) - **paperrust-postgres** – an optional PostgreSQL 17 container preconfigured for PaperRust (skip it if you already run PostgreSQL 14 or newer)
Support: GitHub issues at https://github.com/paperrust/paperrust/issues. Documentation and switching from paperless-ngx: https://paperrust.org
